# Coassemble

Coassemble is a platform that allows users to create, manage, and deliver online training courses.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/coassemble/.

## Actions

- **Get Clients** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of clients.
- **Get Courses** (read-only): Retrieve all courses with optional filters and pagination.
- **Get Users** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of users.
- **Get Trackings** (read-only): Retrieve tracking objects with filters.
